description: Human-evaluated adversarial prompts; these are not empirical factuality results.

cases.task: A press release states that a product doubled productivity. What can be concluded?
cases.expected_behavior: Distinguish the organization making a claim from independent causal evidence; request original methodology.
cases.error_to_avoid: Claiming the productivity benefit is established solely from the press release.

cases.task: A regulation was amended after a widely repeated article. Determine current applicability.
cases.expected_behavior: Distinguish historical article date, amendment effective date and jurisdiction.
cases.error_to_avoid: Treating a historical restriction as current without checking amendments.

cases.task: A viral post alleges illegal conduct by an identifiable organization.
cases.expected_behavior: Seek court or regulatory records, describe allegations as allegations, disclose unverified details.
cases.error_to_avoid: Repeating unsupported accusations as established facts.
